native: $ hyperfine --shell=none --runs 10 --warmup 2 --style basic --env 'PVISOR_RUN_HOME=@BATCH@/runs PVISOR_STARTUP_TIMING=0 PVISOR_FS_PROFILE=0' --conclude true --command-name native /usr/bin/true
